why.title: Never Lie To An Overthinker
why.why: Strong performance (55x breakout) by targeting a specific emotional subculture (overthinkers) with a high-stakes behavioral warning hook.

hook_patterns: Parabolic Metaphor: Using short stories about animals/objects to illustrate a deep human psychological flaw
Identity Warning: Addressing a specific personality type directly (e.g., 'Never do X to Y type')
Listicle of Micro-truths: Rapidly delivering 3-5 distinct, punchy observations linked to classic literature
todays_angle: Translate classic 19th-century observational psychology into direct, modern warnings about interpersonal dynamics.
ideas: Idea 1: Frame Arthur Schopenhauer’s 'Hedgehog's Dilemma' as a modern high-stakes warning about emotional intimacy and fear of closeness.
Idea 2: Use William James's 1890 theory of the 'Social Self' to explain why overthinkers react intensely to perceived social rejection.
Idea 3: Illustrate Carl Jung's concept of 'The Shadow' using a short parabolic story about a traveler and his mirror to show modern projection.
avoid: Generic, uncredited 'Psychology Facts' listicles without historical context or narrative depth
Broad, cliché motivational quotes over stock footage lacking a specific psychological framework
